description: This file defines types, constants, and functions for handling and normalizing execution statuses, including mapping various status strings to canonical statuses, checking status types (terminal, success, failure, etc.), and generating theme configurations for statuses.

methods.name: normalizeExecutionStatus
methods.description: Normalizes a given status string to a canonical status, defaulting to 'unknown' if input is invalid or unrecognized.

methods.name: isTerminalStatus
methods.description: Checks if a status is a terminal state (succeeded, failed, cancelled, timeout).

methods.name: isQueuedStatus
methods.description: Checks if a status is 'queued' or 'pending'.

methods.name: getStatusLabel
methods.description: Returns a human-readable label for a given status.

methods.name: getStatusTheme
methods.description: Returns theme configuration for a given status, normalized to canonical status.
